mentions.name: Gaming Couch
mentions.description: A web-based local multiplayer party game platform described as a mix of Jackbox Games and Mario Party, currently in free Early Access with 18 competitive mini-games. Players use mobile phones (or game pads) as controllers, everything runs in the browser with no downloads or installs, and all games support up to 8 players in action-based rounds of roughly one minute, with no language-based trivia or asynchronous games.
mentions.audience: People playing local multiplayer party games together, joining with mobile phones as controllers (up to 8 players per game)
